lines.text: Maya has hiked five national parks, and she can't remember most of them.
Which trail was it in Zion? How many miles? Who came along? It's all lost in two thousand photos.
Here's the fix. After every park, fill in one page: the date, the trail, the miles, who came along, and the highlight.
Then color in a circle for that park, and watch the count climb.
Now every park has its story.
Save this before your next park trip.
